title: Good job
text: Nice selection, some good products. I liked some of the cookies best. Like that it seems you are avoiding sugar alcohols which neither of us can tolerate. We had a coupon that made the pricing very fair and reasonable. Not sure if we can afford to keep it up all year since we only eat about 2/3 of the box. The bunny keychain was cute. I removed the keychain and it's one of my dogs favorite toys (yes, we watch her closely with it).
label: positive
